name: big5-matrix
description: Big 5 Agent Hierarchy (HDV Foundation) — Hope/Dream/Vision/KNOLL/APEX matrix. Strict separation of concerns.

scripts.ci: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run eval:board && npm run smoke
scripts.ci:python: python3 personamatrix/demo.py && python3 personamatrix/test_model_backend.py && python3 colab/03_behavioral_scoring.py
scripts.plan: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const p=path.resolve('docs/MASTER_PLAN.md');console.error('HDV Foundation MASTER PLAN: '+p+'\n');try{process.stdout.write(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));}catch(e){console.error('Could not read the file. Open it directly: '+p);process.exit(1);}"
scripts.showcase: node -e "const p=require('path').resolve('showcase/index.html');console.log('HDV Foundation showcase (static, no build step).');console.log('Open in a browser:');console.log('  open '+p+'   # macOS');console.log('  xdg-open '+p+' # Linux');console.log('Or serve it (no new deps): npx serve showcase');"
scripts.marketing: node -e "const p=require('path').resolve('marketing/index.html');console.log('HDV Foundation marketing landing page (static, self-contained, no build step).');console.log('Open in a browser:');console.log('  open '+p+'   # macOS');console.log('  xdg-open '+p+' # Linux');console.log('Or serve it (no new deps): npx serve marketing');console.log('Deploy notes: deploy/HOSTINGER.md · GTM: docs/GTM.md');"
scripts.waitlist: node -e "const p=require('path').resolve('marketing/waitlist.html');console.log('HDV Foundation launch waitlist page (static, self-contained).');console.log('Form POSTs to the gateway at /v1/waitlist (public, rate-limited).');console.log('Open in a browser:');console.log('  open '+p+'   # macOS');console.log('  xdg-open '+p+' # Linux');console.log('Preview against a remote gateway: waitlist.html?api=https://your-gateway');"
scripts.handoff: node -e "const p=require('path').resolve('docs/HANDOFF_HOSTINGER.md');console.log('HDV Foundation \u2014 Hostinger/domain deploy HANDOFF:');console.log('  '+p);console.log('New-agent prompt: '+require('path').resolve('docs/AGENT_HANDOFF_PROMPT.md'));console.log('Verify a live box: BASE_URL=https://your-domain npm run verify:public');"
scripts.app:hope: node -e "const p=require('path').resolve('hope/app/index.html');console.log('HOPE live app (static, no build; talks ONLY to the gateway /v1).');console.log('1) start the gateway:  npm run gateway');console.log('2) serve this folder:  npx serve hope/app   (or: python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory hope/app)');console.log('3) open, pointing at the gateway:  http://localhost:3000/?api=http://localhost:8787');console.log('File: '+p+'   ·   Serve note: hope/app/README.md');"
scripts.openapi: node -e "const p=require('path').resolve('docs/openapi.yaml');console.log('HDV gateway OpenAPI spec (main /v1 routes): '+p);console.log('Typed client: packages/sdk (@big5-matrix/sdk)');"
